correctness.rationale: For iid centered R^d increments with finite τ=E||X||²>0, conditional on S_k=0 the independent future has terminal expected quadratic energy (n−k)τ, versus unconditional nτ. Therefore Cov(1_{S_k=0},||S_n||²)=−kτ P(S_k=0), summing yields the exact age-weighted covariance for all n≥1. For one-dimensional simple symmetric walk, odd returns vanish, p_j=binom(2j,j)/4^j and Σ j p_j=N(2N+1)p_N/3, hence Cov=−2N(2N+1)p_N/3. A convolution identity for central-binomial returns gives Var L=2N−3μ_N−μ_N²; Var S_n²=2n(n−1). The asymptotic correlation is −1/(3√(π−2)). Independently enumerated all sign walks n2 through n10 with exact rational arithmetic and checked covariance and both variances.
